# Idun Playground

> Azure AI Foundry dark-mode playground for the NatureLM-Idun-5-MoE agent
> (codename Idun), built in the ai.azure.com visual style.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md) — run, files, architecture
- [ROADMAP](ROADMAP.md) — status quo + phases 2-4
- [Playground doc](docs/playground.md) — Microsoft Learn-style how-to

## What it is

- `playground.html` — Contoso prompt lab + **agent trace panel** (live reasoning +
  web_search tool calls) + live telemetry terminal. No chatbot wheel.
- `api-reference.html` / `auth-guide.html` / `faq.html` — dark Foundry-standard subpages.
- `server.py` — multi-backend router (ThreadingHTTPServer, port 9001) holding
  credentials server-side; relays the `steps` array from the Foundry agent.

## Run

```bash
export FOUNDRY_TOKEN="$(cat ~/foundry_token.txt)"
cd idun-playground
python3 server.py
# open http://127.0.0.1:9001/playground.html
```

## Companion repos

- SDK + CLI: https://github.com/qapdex-maker/idun-sdk
- GitMCP docs mirror: https://gitmcp.io/qapdex-maker/idun-playground
